note: _mortui sunt_ [enim] _Nadab et Abihu_ – [then] Nadab and Abihu died. The Benedictine Vulgate and Weber/Gryson omit the word _enim_, the Clementina and the New Vulgate have it. Historically, _enim_ appears first in the Gutenberg Bible. According to Stummer (_Theologische Revue_ 36 [1937] 307), it may nevertheless be original, because it would reflect Jerome’s translation style.
